---
title: "04_page.qmd"
subtitle: "Step 04 of smoke"
---

- **Purpose.** Summarise the fit per label; a tiny working step for tests/e2e_real.py.
- **Inputs.** `outputs/03_show/source_data/03_show.tsv`
- **Outputs.** `outputs/04_page/04_page.rds` (mean fit per label); this page, `outputs/04_page/04_page.html`.

## Parameters

```{r}
# Parameters -------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP <- Sys.getenv("STEP_DIR") # this step's folder, outputs/04_page, set by the Snakefile
OUTPUTS <- Sys.getenv("OUTPUTS") # outputs/, to read earlier steps
INPUT <- file.path(OUTPUTS, "03_show", "source_data/03_show.tsv")
OUTPUT <- file.path(STEP, "04_page.rds")
```

## Summary

```{r}
# Summary ----------------------------------------------------------------------
summary_table <- aggregate(fit ~ label, data = read.delim(INPUT), FUN = mean)
saveRDS(summary_table, OUTPUT)
summary_table
```

## Session

```{r}
# Session info -----------------------------------------------------------------
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(STEP, "logs", "04_page.session.txt"))
```
